title: Enchanted Footprint Potion
description: A round glass bottle with a cork stopper wrapped in black wire and a spiral metal topper sits centered on a dark surface. The bottle contains a glowing red liquid with visible footprints and bubbles, while a trail of yellowish glowing footprints spills out from its base and winds across the foreground.
prompt: A realistic digital painting of a round glass potion bottle with cork and black wire wrapping, featuring a metal spiral topper with a small anvil charm. The bottle is filled with glowing red liquid containing multiple footprints and bubbles. A trail of luminous yellowish footprints spills from the base and winds across the dark surface. Dramatic lighting with strong highlights and deep shadows on a dark moody background.
